title: TTR/9/2008 of COMMISSIONER COMMERCIAL TAX Vs M/S GANGA BUILDERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Trade Tax Revision No. 9 of 2008
Commissioner, Commercial Tax,
(earlier Trade Tax) Uttarakhand,
Dehradun. .......Revisionist.
Versus
M/s Ganga Builders,
Laxman Jhula Road, Rishikesh,
District Dehradun. .......Respondent
Mr. K.P. Upadhyay, Chief Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / revisionist.
Coram : Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C. J.
Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Barin Ghosh, C.J. (Oral)

Without issuing a notice to the respondent assessee, an
order was passed on 4th January, 2008, thereby, condoning the
delay in filing the revision. That order is palpably illegal as no
order allowing condonation could be passed without notice to the
respondent. No opportunity was given to oppose the Application
for condonation of delay to the respondent assessee. By reason of
non filing of the revision within time, respondent assessee had
acquired a right to proceed on the basis that the order of the
Tribunal has reached its finality and, accordingly, the assessment
process is complete. That right could not be affected without
notice to the assessee. That order being an illegal order, we recall
the same. Despite the order dated 4th January, 2008, no notice was
served upon the assessee. Despite knowledge that the effort made
to serve the notice has failed in view of incorrect address, once
again, incorrect address was furnished for effecting service and, in
that view of the matter, the service was not effected. On 23rd April,

2
2008, the second service returned for the reasons as above. Since
then, no steps have been taken to effect service.
 2. That being the situation, we conclude that the
revisionist was never serious in the matter. The revision
application is not on record unless the Application for condonation
of delay is decided in favour of the revisionist. The same cannot be
decided in favour of the revisionist unless the same has been
served. Revisionist made no effort from the date of filing of the
revision application to effect service of the Application for
condonation of delay. We, accordingly, dismiss all the applications
of the revisionist.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
 11.07.2013 11.07.2013
Rathour
